description: On the counter in front of you are a light green plate, a clear plastic piece off to the right, and a few small items to the left like a purple sponge, a small box, and a yellow toy. The right hand reaches to the right, grips the clear plastic piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward over the plate, then lowers and releases it onto the center of the plate while the left hand stays resting near the left side without touching anything.
